name: Monitored-Property-Column Specification Registry
abstract: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification channel column definitions derived from technique TAPP workbooks. Each $def constrains one column of the channel table, a channel being an instrument selection position -- a mass, a Faraday cup, an energy-loss edge, an X-ray line -- as distinct from the analyte measured on it. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs so they resolve locally through the register.
